mapper.select: select volunteer_training_situation.vtsituation_num, volunteer_training_situation.training_num, volunteer_training_situation.volunteer_num, volunteer_training_situation.vtsituation_id, volunteer_training_situation.vtsituation_begintime, volunteer_training_situation.vtsituation_endtime, volunteer.volunteer_id, volunteer.volunteer_name, volunteer.volunteer_tel from volunteer_training_situation, volunteer where volunteer_training_situation.volunteer_num = volunteer.volunteer_num and volunteer_training_situation.vtsituation_isdeleted = 0 and volunteer.volunteer_isdeleted = 0 and volunteer_training_situation.training_num = #{trainingNum,jdbcType=INTEGER} order by volunteer_training_situation.vtsituation_num asc
select coalesce(max(cast(substring(vtsituation_id, 5) as unsigned)), 0) + 1 from volunteer_training_situation where vtsituation_id like 'vts%' and char_length(vtsituation_id) = 9
